answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity maps to a verified human operator through a signed binding, and any identity later proven sybil forfeits an escrow held against that operator's real account, not the wallet. Because the binding links every alias back to one payer, spawning N fakes costs N forfeitures drawn from a single real balance—an escalating vine of debt they cannot prune. Disputes resolve on a public reef of signed evidence, and repeat offenders face a sable freeze on all linked identities until settlement.
